content: The American Diabetes Association (ADA) publishes the Standards of Care in Diabetes, which outlines the ADA's most recent clinical practice recommendations. These standards encompass critical components of diabetes management, including treatment objectives, evidence-based guidelines, and tools for assessing the quality of care provided to patients. An interprofessional expert committee, known as the ADA Professional Practice Committee, is tasked with revising and updating these standards on an annual basis or more frequently if necessary to reflect the latest advancements in diabetes care. For a comprehensive list of the ADA's standards, position statements, and the evidence grading system used to support these recommendations, readers are encouraged to consult the introduction and methodology sections available on the ADA's official website.
